Show where units can walk and build
Overlays a color layer on the map:
• Land: red is impassable, yellow is walkable but not buildable
• Naval: blue is water ships can use
• Hover: red is impassable even for hover units
• Territory: by walking distance, each tile belongs to the nearest team
• Symmetry diff: red is where the two sides differ

Enlarge or shrink the whole map
Multiply width and height by a factor; ×2 means 4× the area. Terrain is scaled as terrain and transitions re-tiled; trees, bushes and other decor scale too.
Units and pools are never duplicated
: units can “Move to matching position” or “Stay in place”; pools keep their count and move to matching positions by default. Decals keep their size.

Turn an image into a map, with shares you control
1. Pick the image and map size.
2. Pick a mode: color (color maps, screenshots), height (grayscale), or just a tracing reference.
3. Pick a terrain for each main color and drag sliders to set shares, e.g. “water 30%”.
4. Use “Cleanliness” to remove specks and slivers.
5. Tap a region in the preview to change its terrain (changed regions are locked).
6. After generating, connectivity is checked and spawns and pools are placed.
